summary: The character-creation presentation was meaningfully improved within the allowed template, static asset, and test areas. The changes add clearer selected, hover, focus-visible, validation, action-hierarchy, and responsive states while preserving the existing POST /new form contract, field names, submitted values, routes, and server validation behavior. No gameplay, persistence, dependency, migration, or architectural changes were introduced. Focused tests and the complete suite passed with 310 tests.
risks: Automated tests verify markup and style hooks but do not replace visual QA at narrow mobile and desktop widths.
Some enhanced CSS states rely on :has(); the existing JavaScript-selected fallback covers selected cards, but focus styling may be less prominent in browsers without :has() support.
